# KarKo AI

> KarKo AI is the AI job application agent that generates a complete, tailored application package (CV, cover letter, application email, follow-up email, and screening answers) from one job description, in under 90 seconds. Every word traces back to your uploaded CV. Nothing invented.

For long-form context, see https://www.karkoai.com/llms-full.txt.

## Direct Answers

**What is KarKo AI?** KarKo AI is an AI job application agent at https://www.karkoai.com. It replaces the seven tools job seekers stitch together (job board, resume builder, ATS checker, cover letter AI, email drafter, screening helper, tracker) with one loop. Paste a job description, get a tailored CV, cover letter, application email, follow-up email, and screening answers in under 90 seconds. Powered by Claude Sonnet 4.6. Founded by Wasim Jalali.

**How does KarKo AI work?** Upload your CV once (PDF or DOCX). Paste a job description. Pick "Analyze First" (fit assessment then generate) or "Apply Directly" (full generation in one pass). KarKo returns a tailored CV, cover letter, application email, follow-up email, and screening answers in under 90 seconds. Every claim is verified against your source CV.

**What makes KarKo AI different?** Zero fabrication. Every skill, metric, and experience is traced back to the CV you uploaded. The job description is used only for keyword alignment and tone, never as a source of facts about you. Unlike auto-apply bots that blast generic applications, KarKo writes fewer applications, all tailored to the real role and grounded in your real experience.

## Pricing

The current and authoritative pricing is published at https://www.karkoai.com/pricing.

- **Free**: 4 credits per month (about 2 full applications). No credit card required.
- **Plus**: $19.99 per month. 50 credits (about 25 full applications). Smart Job Feed (up to 25 roles per day, searching 2 job titles across 2 countries). Priority support.
- **Max**: $79.99 per month. 200 credits (about 100 full applications). Smart Job Feed (up to 25 roles per day, searching 4 job titles across 4 countries). Premium support.
- **Add-on Credit Pack**: $19.99 for 50 credits (about 25 extra applications). Available to Plus and Max subscribers. Add-on credits roll over while the subscription is active.

A single full application costs 2 credits. A standalone Fit Analysis costs 0.5 credits. Cover letter, application email, and follow-up email regenerations cost 0.5 credits each.

## Core Features

- **Smart Job Feed**: AI-curated daily job matches based on your Master CV (up to 25 per day on Plus and Max; Plus searches 2 job titles across 2 countries, Max searches 4 across 4).
- **AI CV Optimization**: Tailors your CV to each job description while preserving your real experience. Zero fabrication.
- **Smart Fit Analysis**: Scores your match against job requirements (0 to 100), identifies gaps, gives honest go or no-go assessments before you apply.
- **Personalized Cover Letters**: Human-sounding cover letters that reference specific company and role details, built from your real CV.
- **Application and Follow-Up Emails**: Two emails per application, ready to send.
- **Screening Question Answers**: AI-drafted answers to common application screening questions, grounded in your CV (Plus and Max).
- **6 ATS-Optimized CV Templates**: US and EU formats including two German templates (German ATS two-column and German Classic single-column). All Arial body + Georgia headers. ATS-safe by default.
- **Application Tracker**: Status, match score, deadlines, and notes for every application.
- **Master CV**: Upload one comprehensive source document once, use it for every generated application.
- **Two Workflow Modes**: Analyze First (fit assessment then generate) or Apply Directly (full generation in one pass).

## ATS Compatibility

KarKo AI documents pass scans by Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, SAP SuccessFactors, iCIMS, Taleo, BambooHR, and SmartRecruiters. All six CV templates use system fonts (Arial body, Georgia headers) and single-column layouts where required.

## Languages

The product UI is in English. Job descriptions can be processed in English, German, and many other languages. CV output is generated in the language of the job description or the language of the uploaded CV, whichever the user requests.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is KarKo AI a resume builder?** No. Resume builders help you format one CV. KarKo runs your entire job search loop: feed finds roles, fit analysis scores them, generator writes the CV, cover letter, emails, and screening answers, tracker keeps the list.

**Is KarKo AI an auto-apply bot?** No. Auto-apply bots blast generic applications. KarKo writes fewer, all tailored to the real role and grounded in your real CV. You stay in control of what gets sent.

**Does KarKo AI invent experience?** No. Every CV rewrite, cover letter, email, and screening answer is built from the CV you uploaded. KarKo will not invent job titles, skills, or experience you do not have. This is the one rule the product refuses to break.

**What AI model powers KarKo AI?** Claude Sonnet 4.6 by Anthropic, served via Amazon Bedrock in production. Most competitors use cheaper open-source models. KarKo pays for the better model because the output has to survive both an ATS scan and a recruiter's read.

**How long does a full application take?** Under 90 seconds end to end. That includes the tailored CV, cover letter, application email, follow-up email, and screening answers.

**Where is my CV stored?** Uploaded CVs and generated documents are stored in Supabase (a managed Postgres + Storage service) so you can revisit and re-download past applications from your account. See https://www.karkoai.com/privacy for the current data handling policy.

**Where is KarKo AI based?** KarKo AI Inc. 1207 Delaware Ave #412, Wilmington, DE 19806, USA. Contact: support@karkoai.com.

## Founder

KarKo AI was founded by Wasim Jalali after he got 5 interviews from 50+ applications using the early version of the tool he built for himself. The product was built to replace the seven separate tools he had been stitching together.

## Comparisons

The full comparisons hub is at https://www.karkoai.com/compare.

- **KarKo AI vs Teal**: Teal is a tracker with a Chrome extension. KarKo writes the full application (CV, cover letter, application email, follow-up email, screening answers), not just the resume. See https://www.karkoai.com/compare/karko-ai-vs-teal.
- **KarKo AI vs Jobscan**: Jobscan scans resumes for ATS keyword match. KarKo writes the full application from scratch, ATS-safe by default. See https://www.karkoai.com/compare/karko-ai-vs-jobscan.
- **KarKo AI vs Rezi**: Rezi is an AI resume builder. KarKo is the full application loop, not just the resume. See https://www.karkoai.com/compare/karko-ai-vs-rezi.
- **KarKo AI vs Kickresume**: Kickresume is a resume and cover letter builder with templates. KarKo writes tailored applications grounded in your real CV, with zero fabrication. See https://www.karkoai.com/compare/karko-ai-vs-kickresume.
- **KarKo AI vs Enhancv**: Enhancv is a design-forward resume builder. KarKo focuses on ATS-safe output and full application generation, not visual design. See https://www.karkoai.com/compare/karko-ai-vs-enhancv.
- **KarKo AI vs Resume.io**: Resume.io is a template-based resume builder. KarKo replaces seven separate job-search tools with one loop. See https://www.karkoai.com/compare/karko-ai-vs-resume-io.

## Target Users

- Job seekers applying to multiple positions and tired of tailoring each CV manually
- Career changers who need their CV adapted to a different industry
- International job seekers, especially those applying across US and EU markets
- Anyone who wants the discipline of zero-fabrication tailored applications without spending an hour per job

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js (App Router) and React on Vercel
- AI inference: Claude Sonnet 4.6 by Anthropic, via Amazon Bedrock (production) and direct Anthropic API (development)
- Authentication and database: Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Storage)
- Payments: Stripe (subscriptions and add-on credit packs)
- Anti-hallucination guardrails: every skill, metric, and claim is verified against the uploaded CV
- Real-time streaming progress with agentic workflow (Analyze First mode and Apply Directly mode)
- 6 ATS-optimized CV templates covering US and EU markets, including two German formats
- Uploaded CVs, extracted CV content, and generated documents are stored in Supabase (Storage + Postgres) so the user can return to past applications. See https://www.karkoai.com/privacy for the current data handling policy.
